title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates attachments so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Versions and build:
  - Module version is now 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, `openMRSVersion` is 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, webservices.rest is 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and `openmrs-bom` is imported.
  - Builds with Java 21 and `-parameters`.
  - CI (release workflow and Bamboo) uses JDK 21.
- Complex obs handler registration: core 3.0 no longer has an `obsServiceTarget` bean, so `<bean parent="obsServiceTarget">` broke the module context. `DefaultAttachmentHandler` and `ImageAttachmentHandler` are now registered through a `MethodInvokingBean` calling `obsService.setHandlers(...)`.
- Dependencies:
  - `openmrs-web` moves off the api module, because core's `WebConfig` broke the api test context ("No ServletContext set").
  - The api module now declares `spring-web` (provided, for `MultipartFile`).
  - The api's `TestingApplicationContext.xml` is removed. Its only bean, an `xStreamMarshaller`, has no user in the api tests on 3.0, and the omod tests get `WebConfig`'s own.
  - `javax.servlet-api` is dropped, and so are the `javax.servlet` exclusions on `openmrs-web`, which exclude nothing on 3.0.
  - `mockito-inline` 4.8.0 is replaced by BOM-managed `mockito-core`.
- Code: commons-lang becomes lang3, Jackson 1 becomes Jackson 2, `javax.servlet` becomes `jakarta.servlet`, and `javax.activation` becomes `jakarta.activation`. The Swagger model overrides are kept.
- Tests are migrated to JUnit 5. `AttachmentResourceTest` stays disabled, as it was `@Ignore` upstream.
- The README's runtime requirements now say Core 3.0.0, REST 5.0.0 and Java 21.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` passes (36 tests; `AttachmentResourceTest`'s 7 are skipped as before).
- I deployed the omod on openmrs-core master (`mvn jetty:run`, MySQL 8) with legacyui, webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, calculation, fhir2 6.0.0-SNAPSHOT, htmlwidgets, idgen, event, stockmanagement, serialization.xstream, metadatamapping and teleconsultation:
  - All modules started, and the server log has no errors from this module.
  - Logging in through the UI works.
- A real multipart `POST /ws/rest/v1/attachment` of a PNG for a patient returned 201. Listing by patient and `GET .../bytes` (a valid re-encoded PNG) work, and purge returns 204.
  - That needs openmrs/openmrs-module-legacyui#274. Without it, legacyui's `XSSFilter` casts every multipart request to `DefaultMultipartHttpServletRequest`. Core 3.0's `MultipartFilter` produces `StandardMultipartHttpServletRequest`, so any upload fails with a `ClassCastException` while legacyui is installed.
- In a browser, I used O3's Attachments widget (patient-attachments-app 12.3.4, from RefApp 3.7.1) against core master c49ffef, with webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, fhir2 6.0.0-SNAPSHOT and this branch at 6356cb0. legacyui was not installed for this run.
  - Uploading a PNG and a PDF returns 201. The image's thumbnail and preview load, and the server writes a 200×150 thumbnail next to the file.
  - A webcam capture (Chromium's fake camera) is sent as `base64Content` and stored as a 640×480 PNG.
  - The table view lists the files as IMAGE and PDF. `GET .../bytes` returns the PDF byte for byte, and the PNG re-encoded with identical pixels.
  - Deleting from the preview's menu returns 204 and removes the file from the widget.

title: ATT-65: Fix Saving a visit note with multiple image attachments fails
body: Removed the two fields and the unused `getObs()` accessor. `prepareComplexObs` now takes the concept and returns a new `Obs`, and both save methods keep it as a local variable. The bean has no per-call state left, so the singleton scope is safe.

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests
